welcome:
👋 **Hello!**

I am a media downloader bot.
Send me links from **Instagram**, **TikTok**, **YouTube Shorts**, **Twitter/X**, **VK Clips**, **Reddit**, or **Pinterest**, and I'll download and send the video directly to you!
